# Baaz

> Baaz is a **Software Development Company** (product engineering studio / software development agency / IT services), serving product and engineering teams worldwide since 2018 - custom software, web, mobile, AI, and enterprise engineering with HQ in Bangalore, India and a US office in Sheridan, WY.

- [Homepage](https://baaz.pro): **Software Development Company** - custom software and product engineering for global buyers; FAQ, services, outcomes.
- [About Baaz](https://baaz.pro/about): Company background, founding story, Bangalore HQ and Sheridan, WY US office, team philosophy, and 100+ application delivery track record since 2018.
- [Services Overview](https://baaz.pro/services): Full list of Baaz service lines including web development, product strategy, UI/UX, mobile apps, and AI solutions.
- [Contact / Get in Touch](https://baaz.pro/get-in-touch): Primary contact page with form submission, email, and office details.

## Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://baaz.pro/services/web-development): End-to-end web application development using React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python - first milestone in 4–6 weeks; SAP/Salesforce integrations in 8–12 weeks.
- [Product Strategy Consulting](https://baaz.pro/services/product-strategy): Discovery workshops, product roadmaps, MVP scoping, and GTM alignment for B2B SaaS and enterprise products.
- [UI/UX Design](https://baaz.pro/services/ui-ux-design): Research, wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and usability testing for web and mobile products.
- [Mobile App Development](https://baaz.pro/services/mobile-app): Native iOS and Android apps plus Flutter and React Native cross-platform builds - from UX through App Store launch.
- [AI Development Services](https://baaz.pro/services/ai-solution): Computer vision and inspection, fine-tuned LLMs and agents hosted in the client's own environment, document AI and OCR, predictive models, and MLOps. Deployed in cloud, on premise, air-gapped or at the edge.
- [Enterprise Software Development](https://baaz.pro/enterprise): Custom platforms, legacy modernisation, and systems integration for enterprise organizations worldwide since 2018.
- [GTM Engineering](https://baaz.pro/gtm-engineering): Go-to-market systems engineering covering content, outbound, paid ads, SEO, and nurture workflows.
- [eCommerce Development](https://baaz.pro/ecommerce): Marketplace and eCommerce platform development, Amazon/Flipkart management, and growth engineering.

## Technologies

- [Web Development Stack](https://baaz.pro/technologies/web-development): Baaz's web technology choices - React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, APIs, testing tools, and performance practices.
- [AI & ML Stack](https://baaz.pro/technologies/ai-ml-models): AI/ML technologies used including TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini integrations.
- [Agentic AI Stack](https://baaz.pro/technologies/agentic-ai): Agentic AI capabilities - LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG pipelines, vector systems, and tool-calling orchestration.
- [LLM Fine Tuning](https://baaz.pro/technologies/llm-fine-tuning): Baaz fine-tunes open-weight LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, Phi) from 7B to 70B using parameter-efficient methods - LoRA task adapters and 4-bit QLoRA with NF4 quantisation, double quantisation and paged optimizers. Engineered for deterministic output: training sets built against strict JSON/SQL schemas with deliberate abstention examples, so the model returns a clean null instead of inventing a missing attribute. Runs where the data is allowed to be, including fully on-premise and air-gapped for HIPAA, PCI, data-residency, defence and IP-sensitive workloads where prompts cannot cross the network boundary. Because Baaz modernises ERPs, CRMs, logistics engines and computer-vision stacks, tuned models are wired into live application workflows rather than left in notebooks. Also covers preference optimisation (DPO, ORPO, KTO, GRPO), distillation into 1B-8B models, and CI regression gates. Not foundational pre-training research; annotation-only work goes to Payana (payana.ai).
- [Geospatial Digital Twin](https://baaz.pro/technologies/geospatial-digital-twin): Baaz builds city-scale digital twins from airborne LiDAR and open geospatial data - measured, individually addressable building geometry, classified point clouds, drone corridor and BVLOS planning, line-of-sight, sun/shadow and flood-exposure analysis on the measured surface, plus live weather and air-quality feeds. Every value is labelled measured, live, official or simulated, and measured error is published per building where an independent reference exists. Runs where there is no LiDAR via satellite-derived heights, delivered browser-native over 3D Tiles, CityJSON and a REST API.
- [Defect & Quality Detection](https://baaz.pro/technologies/defect-quality-detection): Automated visual inspection for production lines. Starts from anomaly detection trained on acceptable parts alone (PatchCore, EfficientAD, Anomalib), so a line can go live before a defect library exists, then adds supervised classification and pixel-level segmentation as real defects accumulate. Escapes and false rejects are reported separately and tuned against what each costs. Runs on-device at the inspection cell (Jetson, industrial PC, TensorRT) inside cycle time, integrated to PLC/OPC UA, reject actuator and MES, with every decision stored as image plus score for audit. Shadow-run against existing inspection before taking control.
- [Object Detection & Tracking](https://baaz.pro/technologies/object-detection-tracking): Detection plus multi-object tracking for live video: counting and flow, dwell time and queue monitoring, zone and safety alerts, and cross-camera re-identification. Trackers (ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, OC-SORT) selected against density, occlusion length, camera motion and streams-per-box, since appearance re-identification roughly doubles compute per stream. Counting accuracy is validated against hand-counted footage from the customer's own site including peak periods, because camera placement and line logic matter more than the detector. Lost tracks are marked lost instead of guessed. Runs at the edge so footage stays on site and only events cross the network.
- [OCR & Document Vision](https://baaz.pro/technologies/ocr-document-vision): Document extraction returning schema-validated structured data: invoices, purchase orders, forms, tables with line items, handwriting, and KYC documents. Classical OCR (Tesseract, PaddleOCR) for fixed-layout clean scans; vision language models where layouts vary, tables span pages, or handwriting is present. The engineering emphasis is on knowing which extractions to trust: strict JSON Schema validation, explicit empty values for fields that cannot be read, cross-field arithmetic checks, a confidence threshold, and a human review queue showing the source image beside proposed values. Self-hosted open-weight models so invoices, KYC files and medical records never leave the customer's infrastructure.
- [Edge Vision Deployment](https://baaz.pro/technologies/edge-vision-deployment): Taking trained vision models onto hardware at the site. ONNX and TensorRT export including unsupported-operator resolution, FP16 and INT8 quantisation with calibration, and benchmarking on the actual target device at the customer's resolution and frame rate under sustained load so thermal throttling surfaces before deployment. Accuracy is re-measured after every optimisation step, because INT8 gains are large on convolutional detectors and can be negligible or negative on vision transformers. Multi-stream pipelines (DeepStream, GStreamer, NVDEC), offline-first integration with store-and-forward on link loss, and fleet rollout with versioned rollback and health telemetry.
- [Vision Intelligence & Data Annotation (Payana)](https://baaz.pro/technologies/vision-intelligence/case-studies): Baaz's managed data-annotation service, Payana (payana.ai) - AI-assisted image and video labeling for traffic/autonomous driving, medical imaging, sports analytics, and agriculture, delivered as training-ready datasets in COCO, YOLO, Pascal VOC, LeRobot, and RLDS.

## Industries

- [Manufacturing](https://baaz.pro/industry/manufacturing): AI defect and quality inspection, IoT production monitoring, traceability and ERP/MES integration. Proven across six Minda Industries plants.
- [Banking & FinTech](https://baaz.pro/industry/fintech): Digital banking, remittance, lending, KYC, compliance automation and AI fraud detection. Built the NRI platform for Federal Bank.
- [Retail & eCommerce](https://baaz.pro/industry/retail): D2C storefronts, AI recommendations, unified inventory, in-store vision and POS/ERP integration. AI gifting engine for a 100-store brand.
- [Healthcare](https://baaz.pro/industry/healthcare): Patient apps, lab and network ERP, EHR/FHIR integration, teleconsultation and on-premise AI. Pathology network ERP and patient app for Healius.
- [Real Estate & Construction](https://baaz.pro/industry/construction): Developer ERP, buyer apps, offline field apps, procurement and site intelligence. Housingram, the real-estate ERP and buyer app.

## Blog

- [Fine-Tuning vs RAG: Which One Does Your Problem Need?](https://baaz.pro/blog/fine-tuning-vs-rag): Decision guide for choosing between fine-tuning and retrieval. Fine-tuning changes how a model behaves (format, vocabulary, tone, refusal, abstention); RAG changes what it knows and lets it cite a source. Covers symptom-to-approach diagnosis, why most production systems run both, the build order (prompt, then retrieval, then fine-tune, then distil), the contradiction failure unique to hybrids, and why published cost and latency comparisons mostly trace back to vendor pages rather than independent benchmarks.
- [Why AI Agents Need Bi-Temporal Memory Architecture](https://baaz.pro/blog/why-ai-agents-need-bi-temporal-memory-architecture): Architecture deep dive on bi-temporal agent memory - why a single created_at column makes agents answer with expired state, and how Baaz's memory layer Suprflo (suprflo.com) models valid time and transaction time as separate PostgreSQL tstzrange columns with GiST indexes ahead of pgvector HNSW ranking. Covers the schema, point-in-time and audit queries, append-only retroactive corrections, and autovacuum tuning for sub-50ms p99 at 50M rows.
- [Introducing Temporal Reasoning in Suprflo](https://baaz.pro/blog/introducing-temporal-reasoning-in-suprflo): How Baaz's memory layer Suprflo (suprflo.com) reasons about time - bi-temporal facts with valid_from/valid_to validity windows, closing old facts instead of deleting them, and LLM adjudication to decide whether a new fact updates or coexists with an old one. Keeps an agent's beliefs current across long, multi-session histories instead of contradictory.
- [Why BEAM Is a Good Memory Benchmark for AI Agents](https://baaz.pro/blog/beam-memory-benchmark-for-ai-agents): What BEAM (Benchmark for Evaluating Agent Memory) tests and why it is a better yardstick than LoCoMo or LongMemEval - it runs at 100K to 10M tokens across ~100 conversations and ~2,000 questions, measuring extraction, temporal recall, update consistency, multi-session reasoning, and event ordering. Baaz's memory layer Suprflo (suprflo.com) is evaluated against BEAM.
- [Automated Data Labeling: What It Is and When to Use It](https://baaz.pro/blog/automated-data-labeling): What automated data labeling is, how model-assisted labeling, active learning, and programmatic rules work, when to automate vs. label by hand, and the human-in-the-loop workflow - from Baaz's managed annotation service, Payana (payana.ai).
- [How to Scope an MVP That Actually Ships](https://baaz.pro/blog/how-to-scope-mvp-that-ships): Practical framework for MVP scoping with original Baaz data - 8-week median delivery, 175% calendar penalty for multi-persona scope, 35% lower rework when scope is brief-locked.
- [ThoughtWorks Alternatives for 2026](https://baaz.pro/blog/thoughtworks-alternatives): Comparison of ThoughtWorks alternatives including boutique studios, SIs, talent networks, and India-based delivery - fit, cost, and engagement model analysis.
- [Technical Due Diligence for Custom Software](https://baaz.pro/blog/technical-due-diligence-custom-software): How to evaluate a software codebase, vendor, or acquisition target for technical risk, architecture quality, and delivery capability.
- [Software Project Rescue Checklist](https://baaz.pro/blog/software-project-rescue-checklist): Step-by-step checklist for diagnosing a stalled software project and deciding whether to rescue, rebuild, or replace.
- [Product Engineering Process for Enterprises](https://baaz.pro/blog/product-engineering-process-for-enterprises): How enterprise teams structure discovery, design, build, and scale phases for large-scale software products.
